contract.summary:
Outcome: add an optional emoji marker before greeting output. Success means a caller can enable the marker per greeting call with a single optional boolean flag/parameter; when enabled, the greeting output is prefixed with exactly `👋 `, and when false or omitted, output remains unchanged.

In scope: one optional built-in emoji marker for greeting output, enabled explicitly per call. Out of scope: global config-driven behavior, caller-supplied arbitrary prefixes or emojis, and any other output changes.

Confirmed decisions: callers enable the feature with a dedicated optional flag/parameter per greeting call; the built-in marker is exactly `👋`; enabled formatting is exactly the existing greeting string prefixed with `👋 `.

Failure, edge, and misuse behavior: if the flag/parameter is false or omitted, behavior must match current output exactly; no alternative emoji or formatting should be inferred.

Constraints: preserve existing greeting behavior unless explicitly enabled; do not widen the API beyond a single optional boolean control.

Implementation authorization: not authorized by this interview alone.
